children: VANCOUVER, BRITISH COLUMBIA, SEPTEMBER 9, 2026 – TheNewswire - HI-VIEW RESOURCES INC. (“Hi-View” or the “Company”) (CSE: GXLD; OTCQB: GXLDF; FSE: B630) announces they will be presenting in Prince George on Thursday, September 10th from 3:30 pm to 6:30 pm at the Rockford Grill at 2990 Recreation Place (Sandman Signature Hotel) courtesy of Resource Connector North https://www.resourceconnector.ca/.

Hi-View is advancing five projects across more than 27,000 hectares in British Columbia's Toodoggone Gold & Copper District, working with Tsay Keh Dene First Nation to develop and advance these projects in Northern BC. The portfolio sits near major discoveries including Aurora, and advanced development sites such as Kemess, Ranch, Lawyers, Mets, Baker, and Shasta.
The presentation will cover Hi-View's projects alongside neighbouring activity in the district, including the Kemess Mine, Thesis Gold, and more than 35 other mining and exploration projects.

Hi-View Resources Inc., a publicly listed mineral exploration company on the Canadian Securities Exchange, is advancing a portfolio of gold, silver, and copper assets in the Toodoggone region of northern British Columbia. The Company’s 100% owned and optioned projects cover more than 27,910 hectares and include the flagship Golden Stranger Project, the Lawyers claims, and the Borealis Project — all designated as high-priority targets. Additional properties under option include Saunders, Black Pearl, Oxide Summit, Nub, Ursus, Garnet, and Harmon Peak. The company also has an additional 1,300 hectares currently under mineral claim application. For more information, please visit Hi-View’s website or review the Company’s filings on SEDAR+ (www.sedarplus.ca).
